scope_override: The CUSTOMER is a developer or an AI agent, and the product is horizontal plumbing that is domain-agnostic: agent SDKs/frameworks, orchestration, sandboxes and browsers for agents to act in, agent observability/eval/debugging, memory and context stores, agent auth/payments/identity rails, control planes for running agents, or software built to be consumed by agents rather than humans. It would work for any industry. INCLUDE a company selling a platform or toolkit so OTHER teams build their own agents, even when sold to enterprises. EXCLUDE a finished agent that performs one industry's work (that is vertical-agents) and EXCLUDE horizontal business software that merely uses agents internally.

scope_override: The CUSTOMER is an end business in a SPECIFIC industry or job function, and the product is a working agent that performs that industry's actual labour: medical billing, tax prep, insurance claims, recruiting screens, dental or clinic front desk, freight dispatch, legal intake, audit, construction scheduling, restaurant ops, and the like. The value is embedded domain knowledge and workflow, not the plumbing. INCLUDE a finished agent doing one industry's or one function's work even when the underlying technology is impressive. EXCLUDE developer platforms for building agents (that is agent-infrastructure) and EXCLUDE generic horizontal software with no industry specialisation.
